normalized_problem_statement: Enhance the existing URL shortener to track how many times each short URL has been successfully resolved and expose analytics for a short code. Preserve all existing shortening and redirect behavior.
assumptions: Counts are process-local and are not persisted across restarts.

functional_requirements.text: Expose redirect analytics for a known short code.
Return a defined error for analytics on an unknown code.
Preserve current shortening and redirect behavior.

nonfunctional_requirements.text: The enhancement must remain deterministic and dependency-free.

constraints.text: Use the existing in-memory architecture and bounded repository context.

acceptance_criteria.text: Analytics lookup does not increment redirect_count.
Existing shorten and redirect behavior remains compatible.

risks.text: Incorrect placement of counting could count failed or analytics lookups.
